title: GraphNode Manifest
description: The card one packaged thing (an emitter, skill, tool, rule or workflow) carries as manifest.yaml in its folder. YAML on disk; validated as its JSON equivalent (design.md 21, 22, 27). An emitter card also requires module, repo and emits.

name.description: On an emitter, two segments, Emitter.<Source> (Emitter.Git, not Emitter.Git.Repository): the facet goes in emits, never in the name. A name of more than two segments on an emitter is a warning, code emitter-name.

module.description: The module the thing is, by the name its runtime imports, e.g. Graph.Emitter.Git.Repository; for an emitter, the module its envelopes name in module. No whitespace. Required on an emitter.

repo.description: The source repository the thing is built from, by name, e.g. Graph.Emitter.Git.Repository. No whitespace. Required on an emitter.

url.description: Where the repository lives, an http or https URL with no whitespace, e.g. https://github.com/JerryBalmer1/Graph.Emitter.Git.Repository.

emits.description: What the emitter writes, one item per facet: the facet (one face of its source, a kind of layer) and the node Kinds a layer of that facet holds. Required on an emitter.

needs.description: What the thing needs to run: another packaged thing, a runtime or a tool on PATH.

verbs.description: What the thing does, each with the strongest effect it can have.

extends.description: The name of the card this one builds on (an overlay on its base, a policy on the vocabulary it governs). Checked as a well-formed name only; it need not resolve to a card in the same repo. Distinct from needs, which is what the thing needs to run.

files.description: The files the card ships, relative to the card's folder, forward slashes, e.g. vocabulary.yaml, steps.yaml. Never absolute, never a . or .. segment, no backslash or colon.

pins.description: Exact versions of other packaged things this one was built against, name -> semver, e.g. {"Graph.Node": "0.3.0"}.

name.description: Dotted: two or more segments, each a letter then letters, digits or hyphens, e.g. Emitter.Terraform, Graph.Node.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the card's folder: segments joined by /, none empty, . or .., no backslash or colon.

facet.description: One face of an emitter's source, lower-case words joined by single hyphens, e.g. repository, runs, schema.

kind.description: A node Kind name, as node.schema.json's kind, e.g. Commit, PolicyDecision.

kinds.description: the node Kinds a layer of this facet holds, declared in the emitter's ontology

name.description: a packaged thing's dotted name, or a runtime or tool (PowerShell, terraform)

version-range.description: the versions that work, e.g. >=7.4, ^0.3.0, >=1.5 <2.0; absent means any

os.description: where the need applies; absent means any

description.description: what the verb does, in words; the cmdlet or executable that runs it goes in command, not here

command.description: the cmdlet or executable that runs the verb, e.g. Invoke-FileSystemDiscover, git fetch; absent when the verb is the command's own name

effect.description: the strongest thing the verb can do outside its own output: read (changes nothing), write (creates or changes something), destroy (can delete). Writing the verb's own output (the envelope or report it was asked for), local refs, the plan file and ledger lines is not an effect; discover, plan, run, report and fetch verbs are read unless they change something outside their own output

os.description: where the verb runs; absent means all

targets.description: the names of the cards the verb applies to, e.g. an overlay's apply or a policy's evaluate naming Base.Infrastructure; checked as well-formed names only
